look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Follow the climbing vine to a node and look for a short papery sheath (ocrea) around the stem, a Polygonaceae clue. Check alternate leaves, often with heart-shaped bases. At fruiting, look for drooping clusters of small achenes carried on elongated winged flower stalks; the wing is on the stalk, not the leaf.
